body:
In fact, YUI compressor can only deal with ES3, not ES5 (I tried it myself). No current browser has the behavior of throwing errors on code like exports.default or default, and some other words inside object literals. I think your best option will be to turn off compression with YUI in AEM dashboard.

The problem is that YUI is acting like IE8, not like any recently released browser, and thus can't be supported. The babel steps I listed higher are a first step, but still likely not enough to make it minifyable. We have a minified version of InstantSearch available on CDNs, so there shouldn't be a need to reminify yourself

See https://helpx.adobe.com/experience-manager/kb/how-to-change-the-minification-engine-for-client-libraries-in-AEM.html for more info!
